messages:
Alice M: Hey folks — noticed spiky alerts from "queue_depth_high" overnight for gpu-pool-nyc. Grafana shows big noise around 03:00-04:00. Can we sanity-check alert logic? @Ben (infra) @Carol SRE

Ben (infra): saw that, I think autoscaler bursts made short lived queues. Alerts firing on 1m avg => noisy. Will paste current rule.

Carol SRE: yup. Also batch_saturation_ratio metric jumps when batchers flush at low q. We should smooth and add debounce.

Ben (infra): current rule:
```yaml
alert: QueueDepthHigh
expr: avg_over_time(redwood_queue_depth{pool="gpu-pool-nyc"}[1m]) > 50
for: 2m
labels: severity:warning
```

Ben (infra): That's too short. Suggest change to 5m avg and 4m for.

Emma (platform): +1. Also dashboard uses panel id 42 which plots raw series; can we add an aggregated panel showing "burst_count" and 95th of queue depth?

Dan (oncall): hunch: cross-region routing flaps cause short bursts when region fallback fires. We saw same pattern last month.

Carol SRE: agree. Recommend:
- Use `increase(redwood_router_fallback_total[5m])` on dashboard
- Replace 1m avg with `avg_over_time(...[5m])`
- Add alert: `sum by(pool)(avg_over_time(redwood_batch_saturation_ratio[5m]) > 0.9)` with longer for.

observability-bot: Created ticket INF-2392 to track rule updates and dashboard change. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-2392

Alice M: Nice. Cost side — if we lengthen for windows, we might delay noticing real saturation and SLOs could be impacted. How to balance?

Ben (infra): we can keep a high-severity alert on p99 latency as backup:
```
alert: ServingLatencyHighP99
expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]) > 2
for: 3m
```
Ben (infra): that'll catch sustained customer impact.

Emma (platform): UI suggestion: add a compact "debounced" panel that shows alert state after 3m suppressions, and a "raw spikes" panel for devs to investigate.

Dan (oncall): Also want per-customer queue_depth labels — high peekers skew pool averages. Can we add percentile-based alerting: `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(redwood_queue_depth_bucket[5m])) > 40` ?

Carol SRE: Good idea. We'll prototype that.

Alice M: Action items:
1) Ben update Prom rule -> avg 5m, for 4m, add p99 latency rule. (INF-2392)
2) Emma update Grafana panels (42, 67) with debounced view and fallback metrics.
3) Carol/Dan prototype percentile alert.
4) Observability-bot link to dashboards + test runbook

observability-bot: INF-2392 updated: assignees Ben, Emma, Carol. ETA: 48h.

Ben (infra): I'll open a change PR for alertmap and run in staging.

Emma (platform): I'll add mock panels and share snapshot.

Dan (oncall): I'll watch alerts during next canary deploy tonight.

Alice M: thanks all :thumbsup:
